parsed.explanation: No criminalisation, no border/document friction documented (foreign passports, visa-free 90 days), no bathroom or ward ban, and courts genuinely work for trans people: a 2024 human-rights-court ruling ordering damages for denied HRT in prison, and a February 2025 Supreme Court finding of gender discrimination against a non-binary worker. Against that: no hate-crime/hate-speech coverage for gender identity (amendments vetoed and struck down), so recourse after violence is thin; a documented 2024 case of a trans foreign national placed in a male migrant centre with three months' HRT denial (remedied only by NGO intervention); entrenched social hostility (LGBT-free-zone legacy, violent 2019 march, head-of-state rhetoric). The 2019 victimisation figure is stale and given no weight. Worst documented feature is narrow, conditional custody exposure plus unresolved social hostility — clearly above the 0.45 universal-exposure tier, below the 0.65 tier where service remedies and acceptance are demonstrated.
